text: This report recommends the 2019 meeting schedule for the Sign Variance Committee. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council’s approved schedule, the Committee’s preference for meeting on Tuesdays, and the availability of meeting space.
The Sign Variance Committee: 1. Approved the 2019 meeting schedule dates in Attachment 1 to the report (January 15, 2019) from the Deputy Secretary, Sign Variance Committee.
